content: This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. However, it is important to be aware of the following: 1. Severe Intestinal Condition: This medication may rarely cause a serious intestinal condition due to an overgrowth of a bacterium called Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile). This condition can occur during treatment or even weeks to months after the treatment has been discontinued. Symptoms may include persistent diarrhea, abdominal pain, or blood/mucus in the stool. If these symptoms occur, contact your doctor immediately. 2. Prolonged or Repeated Use: Using this medication for extended periods or repeatedly may lead to the development of a new infection caused by resistant organisms. This is because prolonged antibiotic use can disrupt the balance of normal bacteria in your body. 3. Allergic Reactions: Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare but possible. Symptoms of a serious allergic reaction may include rash, itching/swelling (especially of the face, tongue, or throat), severe dizziness, or trouble breathing. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience any of these symptoms. 4. Dizziness: This medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks that require alertness until you are sure you can do so safely. Limit your consumption of alcoholic beverages. 5. Vaccines: This medication may interfere with the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. Inform your healthcare provider if you are scheduled to receive any vaccinations. 6. Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, as its effects on the fetus are not fully known. It is also unclear whether this drug passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding. 7. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 8. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.). For non-emergency overdoses, contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. 9. Lab Tests: While using this medication, your doctor may order laboratory or medical tests, such as kidney function tests, to monitor your progress and check for side effects. It is important to keep all medical and lab appointments. 10. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose of this medication, follow these instructions: For injections: Contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. For inhaled doses: Use the missed dose as soon as you remember, unless it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose. In that case, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 11. Storage: If you are using this medication as an inhalation, store the unmixed vials at room temperature. Do not use premixed solutions or prepare the solution in advance, as this increases the risk of serious breathing problems. Prepare the inhalation solution immediately before use and discard any unused solution after 24 hours. Do not store the solution for longer periods or in the bathroom. 12. Proper Disposal: Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company for guidance. 13. Important Information: This document provides a summary of key information about this medication but does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information tailored to your specific health needs. 14. Usage Instructions: If you are administering this medication at home, ensure you have been properly trained by your healthcare provider. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the liquid if it appears abnormal. If inhaling this medication, learn how to properly prepare the solution and use the nebulizer machine. For optimal results, use this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals and complete the full prescribed course, even if symptoms improve after a few days. 15. Side Effects: Common side effects may include stomach upset and itching. If these persist or worsen, inform your doctor. Remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefit to you outweighs the risk of side effects. Always follow your healthcare provider’s instructions and contact them if you have any questions or concerns about this medication.
